title: The BKAR forest interpolation formula
abstract: Proves the Brydges–Kennedy–Abdesselam–Rivasseau forest interpolation formula for smooth functions on a finite complete graph’s edge-coupling space, with unordered forest-cube contributions, ordered sector variants, and choice independence.

informal.BKAR.bkar_formula_forestIndex_cube_contr: A smooth function evaluated at the all-one configuration is the sum over forests of cube integrals of mixed partial derivatives at path-minimum interpolation points.
